items.title: Store hashed session credentials with Argon2id instead of SHA-256?

context.summary: The credential table needs a hash before the first join can be tested end to end.
context.tried: Prototyped both: SHA-256 with a server pepper verifies in microseconds; Argon2id with the OWASP minimum takes about 40 ms per request on the VM.

options.label: SHA-256 + pepper
options.detail: Credentials are long random tokens, so a slow hash adds little; fastest per request.

options.label: Argon2id
options.detail: Defence in depth if a token generator is ever weak; 40 ms on every signed call.
